_meta.description: Canonical navigation layout applied AFTER all manifest.d fragments merge (see buildManifest in @conduction/nextcloud-vue). Fragments stay the source of WHAT exists in the menu (ADR-037); this file is the single place deciding WHERE entries live. relocations: sourceId -> targetGroupId. removals: leaf menu-entry ids retired as duplicate navigation — their PAGES stay routable for deep links. settingsSection: leaf ids lifted into Nextcloud's settings foldout (the bottom-left gear / NcAppNavigationSettings, OUTSIDE the scrollable nav) — integration/connection plumbing and configuration that is setup-time, not daily browse.
